focus.decision: In before.png the route-facing building fronts are unbroken flat slabs (the large red wall at left), the single emptiest element versus the Chicago reference's brownstone wall. Revise Art/street.py to add facade relief to those existing building volumes: recessed window bays with dark glass planes, projecting sills/lintels, a cornice band under the roofline, and one stoop of three steps with post-and-rail at an entry, plus a shallow planter strip at the wall base. Decorative meshes only — collider volumes, camera, actor scale, pavement, route and markers unchanged. The next like-for-like frame must show the left wall divided into repeated window bays with cast shadow relief, a distinct cornice line, and a stoop meeting the sidewalk.

focus.measured_correction: Measured correction from actual v0039 native evidence, not a gameplay redesign: the newly exported alley_wallW/E cross the accepted road. Their first world centers are (-3.10,2.80,12.85) and(-3.10,2.80,14.95), sizes(11.60,5.60,0.30); the car stops at Z10.55 under throttle instead of reachingZ27.85. These alley meshes were absent from the accepted102a2095 FBX even though the current Art script already contained their creation block. Re-export exposed that source/export mismatch. Fix the Art/street.py alley placement or remove that previously unexported alley section so the accepted X-1..6,Z-2..30 route remains physically open. Do not disable colliders, move anchors, widen targeting, or alter C# to pass the replay. The chosen large blank wall is the SOUTH END FACE of facade_wall, not its already windowed front. Measured mapping for the first module is worldX=-0.9-BlenderY, worldY=BlenderZ, worldZ=7+BlenderX; alley_wallW at Blender(5.85,2.2,2.8) confirms this. The visible end is therefore BlenderX=-6. Add real decorative window/brick/stone relief on that end plane, outward toward negativeBlenderX. Keep these decorations outside the playable pavement, with original facade_wall/base geometry intact. The previous added front mullions/piers did not improve the blank wall in before.png. Make a clearly visible architectural improvement to that exact face, not another minor front trim edit. Keep original Blender source and export provenance; one existing asset only.

review.summary: At the same stationary spawn camera, after.png (t3.2) is a clear geometry improvement over before.png (v0039 frame-000): the left route-facing wall, previously one unbroken red slab crossed only by a pole shadow, now reads as an articulated facade — two recessed dark-glass window bays with projecting cream lintels and sills, vertical pier divisions, a projecting horizontal stone band at upper left, and a light base strip at the wall line. These are new meshes with self-shading, not a lighting/color change, so the bounded facade-relief gap is addressed. drive.png (t15.5) shows no blocking regression: the trace confirms the vehicle still reaches the pad (closest driving approach 0.68 m, delivery at Z24.9, mission_complete) and all walk/world/motor/courier/combat regression tests pass; the frame's crowding is a composition/marker-clipping flaw, not a route blockage. Acceptance is bounded: this fixes the blank wall, not the overall Chicago fidelity, and two stated acceptance items (stoop, readable cornice) are still not visible in the like-for-like after.png frame.
